title: SUCURI: SymPy Unified Compiler for Unambiguous Rendered Input
description: SUCURI reads LaTeX into SymPy without guessing: every ambiguity in the notation is either asked or settled by an explicit declaration. It covers index and index-free notation for differential geometry — connections, curvature, forms, proofs from stated hypotheses and component computations — with a notebook interface in English and Portuguese.
